takeTwoCard.title: Take-Two PC port
takeTwoCard.text: Take-Two Interactive has not announced an official PC port for GTA VI, maintaining focus on console platforms while aggressively protecting intellectual property. The ongoing leak has accelerated community reverse-engineering efforts, but no official timeline or confirmation has been issued. The company's stance remains consistent with prior GTA titles: PC releases arrive only after console campaigns stabilize.

fanProjectCard.title: Fan-made Projects
fanProjectCard.text: Community-driven PC port projects have achieved significant technical milestones, including bootability, in-game rendering, and initial visuals, but performance remains severely limited at ~4 FPS. Multiple recompilation teams face intermittent setbacks from Rockstar IP enforcement actions, yet momentum remains high with daily progress reported across independent GitHub and compilation projects.
